skills.name: efs-components-best-practices
skills.description: Integrate J.P. Morgan Embedded Finance & Solutions (EF&S) into a partner platform - Embedded Payments and Digital Onboarding REST APIs, the @jpmorgan-payments/embedded-finance-components React library (EBComponentsProvider, OnboardingFlow, LinkedAccountWidget, RecipientsWidget, PaymentFlow, Accounts, TransactionsDisplay), partially hosted onboarding through session transfer and an iframe, and webhooks. Use when building or debugging an EF&S integration, choosing between REST-only, embedded components, or hosted UI, or looking up the official recipes, OpenAPI specs, and showcase demos.
